# 📘 Tutorial Review Checklist

- [ ] Learning objective is explicit.
- [ ] Prerequisites and installation commands are correct.
- [ ] Code snippets match current source.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic and reproducible.
- [ ] Expected output is either verified or clearly illustrative.
- [ ] Mathematical claims cite an appropriate source.
- [ ] Known limitations are prominent.
- [ ] No production/high-impact claims are made.
- [ ] Keyboard/accessibility considerations are documented.
- [ ] Internal links resolve.
